description: Systèmes d'endiguement is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte des Milieux Aquatiques et des Rivières de l'Aude. Containment systems (the dykes) are structures created by humans in order to prevent, within a certain limit, water from entering areas of stake (inhabited, industrial...). In fact, they are usually built parallel to a stream or coast. Coverage: Syndicat Mixte des Milieux Aquatiques et des Rivières de l'Aude. The portal shows the English title as "Containment systems" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Mixte des Milieux Aquatiques et des Rivières de l'Aude. Its keywords include digue. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS, SHP, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
